title: Deleting a Chat deletes its local messages, bans and attachments
description:
Mark decided 2026-11-20. JMAP Chat/set destroy (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 'Destroying a Chat') removes the Chat from the caller's view and MUST NOT delete history for other participants; it does not require keeping the caller's own copy. Today crate-jmap keeps a destroyed Chat's Messages and ChatBans, so they stay as plaintext in chat.json, unreachable and forever.

Do: when a front end deletes a chat, the store deletes that room's Message, Ban and ReadPosition records and drops its blobs from the referenced set (so blob retention frees them), plus tombstones so a journal replay does not bring messages back. Also purge items kept with an unknown room by the format-1 conversion (§7.8) on the next save. Lives in mimid-agent-store, not crate-jmap. Record as §7.9 in docs/design/agent-frontends.md. Test: destroy a Chat with messages, a ban and an attachment; after restart nothing of it is in the file or blob dir, and other rooms are untouched. After mimid-1vul.5 (outbound through the store).
